thread:
kira: Cutting RC for edge-proxy sha=3f9a2b7. Opening RC now. Change window 2026-04-02 01:00-03:00 UTC. Need QA + sheriff for canary.

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] RC created: rc/3f9a2b7-20260402 (id: 6011). Artifacts pinned: edge-proxy:3f9a2b7. Promote to canary: `/deploy promote rc/6011 --env canary --percent 3 --kv-warm`

sam: staging smoke looks clean, exception rate low. small warning about header parsing in one trace.

qa: paste sample log?

sam: ```text
2026-04-01T20:14:02Z WARN header parse failed user=442 path=/v1/route
```

releng: added release notes entry: "Edge proxy: improved prefix routing and header sanitizer; no DB changes; recommend KV warm prior to ramp." link: https://redwood.internal/release/6011

sheriff: I'm on for the window. Pre-approved rollback target: edge-proxy:2d7c8f0. Rollback cmd: `kubectl set image deploy/edge-proxy edge-proxy=2d7c8f0 -n prod`

kira: promoting to canary 3% now. `/deploy promote rc/6011 --env canary --percent 3 --kv-warm`

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started rc/6011 -> canary (3%). KV warm in progress (45s).

kira: KV warm done. Watch p95 latency and upstream 502s.

qa: canary smoke ok. latency stable, 502 rate 0.05% -> 0.12% small bump.

sam: holding 15m. if 502 > 0.8% for 5m we abort.

kira: starting prod ramp: `/deploy promote rc/6011 --env prod --stages 10,50,100 --wait-metrics`

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Prod ramp started -> stage 10%. Notifying oncall.

sheriff: getting an alert: spike in 502s from upstream-auth at 10% stage. threshold hit at 01:12 UTC. Recommend pause.

kira: pausing at 10%. `/deploy abort-stage rc/6011 --reason "upstream-auth 502 spike"`

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Ramp paused at 10%. Reason: metric(upstream_auth_502) breached threshold.

sam: quick grep of traces shows increased timeouts on auth handshake coincident with proxy header sanitizer hitting certain long headers. example trace: `auth-handshake timeout 1200ms header_len=2048`

qa: looks like old clients sending large headers that now exceed default buffer. Repro locally with curl -H "X-Long: <2k chars>".

releng: options: (1) rollback to 2d7c8f0 for prod, (2) apply temporary header-size increase on prod ingress and continue ramp, (3) traffic-shim route suspicious clients to old variant. Thoughts?

sheriff: prefer safest: rollback. But if we can flip an ingress knob without deploy, that's OK for short term. Is there an ingress flag?

sam: we can bump nginx proxy buffer size via configmap `nginx-proxy-buffer=8k` without rolling edge-proxy images. That should mitigate 502s for most clients. Quick config apply and reload takes ~2m.

kira: do it. Apply ingress change and monitor for 5m. If 502s return to baseline, resume ramp. Otherwise rollback.

sam: applying config now: `kubectl apply -f ingress-configmap.yaml && kubectl rollout restart ds/nginx-proxy -n infra`

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Config apply detected. Rolling restart of nginx-proxy daemonset.

sheriff: watching metrics.

qa: after restart 502s dropped back to baseline within 90s. p95 latency unchanged.

kira: resuming ramp from 10% to 50%. `/deploy promote rc/6011 --env prod --resume --stages 50,100`

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Resuming promotion rc/6011 -> prod. Next stage 50%.

sheriff: monitoring. If 502 reappears or error >1% for 5m we abort and rollback.

releng: updating release note to mention header buffer change applied as mitigation and that a follow-up RC will include a safer header sanitizer with configurable buffer.

sam: 50% stage looks fine after 15m. No further 502s.

kira: promoting to 100%. `/deploy promote rc/6011 --env prod --stages 100`

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion to 100% complete. Prod now running edge-proxy:3f9a2b7.

qa: post-deploy smoke OK. Closing watch.

kira: Postmortem note: "RC 6011: header sanitizer rejected long headers causing upstream-auth 502s during ramp. Applied ingress buffer bump to mitigate, resumed and completed promotion. Follow-up: land two changes - (a) make sanitizer tolerant with configurable cap, (b) add synthetic test with long headers. Assigned to @sam and @releng."

sheriff: ack. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
